description: This Java class models the <engine> element in a configuration XML, representing an engine with parameters, including methods for accessing its attributes and parameters.

classes.name: Engine
classes.description: A thread-safe class representing an <engine> configuration element with attributes and parameters.

methods.name: Engine
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Engine object from an XML Element, extracting attributes and parameters.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Returns the class name of the engine.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the engine.

methods.name: getParameter
methods.description: Retrieves a Parameter object by its name.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Returns the list of all parameters.

methods.name: getParameterValue
methods.description: Returns the value of a parameter by its name.
